purpose: Check saved-model numeric reproducibility and inference invariance to opaque row identifiers, input filenames and a fixed row permutation.
scope: The final six native host/phage pairs, for each of paired, host_only and phage_only bundles. No retraining, gene calling, protein search, vocabulary construction, feature selection or calibration is repeated.
before_replay: Freeze a run manifest binding the completed native score receipt, both actual final feature reports, all three bundle manifests and artifacts, this policy, exact worker source/command, runtime and fresh destinations before any replay score is computed.

numeric_replay.procedure: Reconstruct each six-row input matrix from the authenticated host and phage feature reports, preserving the exact frozen feature schema. In a fresh locked-runtime process load each saved bundle through score_bundle and compare every raw margin with the original saved score.

opaque_replay.packet: Serialize only opaque row IDs, reordered numeric feature rows, the exact feature schema and frozen bundle bindings to a fresh opaque-named input file. Keep the opaque-to-original row map outside the scorer input. The worker scores the packet in a separate fresh process and returns opaque IDs and margins.
opaque_replay.comparison: After worker output is saved, the controller reverses the fixed permutation and compares all 18 raw margins with the original scores and numeric replay.

acceptance.comparison: Exact equality of finite stored float margins after restoration of original row order. Report every difference and maximum absolute difference per scope even when all values match.
acceptance.failure: Preserve inputs, outputs, process exits and all discrepancies. Mark the corresponding replay failed; do not silently loosen tolerances, change parameters, overwrite outputs or retry for a passing result. A replay failure is a technical issue, not evidence of biological prediction failure.

provenance: Record command arguments, Python/package versions, all input/output SHA256 bindings, observed worker exits and pre/post bundle hashes. Require unchanged original score receipt, feature reports, bundles and protocol.
interpretation_limits: This is an inference-boundary replay, not an anonymous end-to-end sequence-to-feature rerun. It cannot establish label isolation of feature preparation or training.
Opaque row names are not model features; invariance is an expected software property rather than biological signal.
Workers receive no target phenotype vector. No claim is made that their filesystem or saved bundle provenance makes all phenotype information inaccessible.
Method selection previously saw native labels. Passing replay does not turn this exploratory retrospective analysis into a blind study.
Matching numeric scores does not validate receptor recognition, binding, tail-fiber assembly or productive infection.
